cohort: 114 participants aged 18-45 years, ≥24 weeks' gestation, who received a postplacental IUD inserted after vaginal or cesarean delivery
finding: The expulsion rate at 6 months after postplacental insertion did not differ between the levonorgestrel and copper IUD types, after adjusting for patient-level factors and delivery route.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in expulsion rates at 6 months postpartum between levonorgestrel and copper IUDs inserted after both vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
